name: The Hungerbühler–Wasem generalized residue theorem
text: the residue theorem for contours passing *through* poles (under mild crossing regularity): the integral becomes a principal value, the winding number a generalized one taking non-integer values on the contour.

name: The generalized winding number
text: (Hungerbühler–Wasem Def 2.1), with their real bounded-integrand formula Prop 2.3.

name: The argument principle
text: the contour integral of `f'/f` counts zeros minus poles, weighted by winding number.

name: The homology form of Cauchy's theorem
text: the integral of a holomorphic function over a cycle null-homologous in the domain vanishes.

name: Jordan's lemma
text: the decay estimate for semicircular arcs in Fourier-type residue evaluations.

name: The Riemann mapping theorem
text: every simply connected proper open subset of `ℂ` is biholomorphic to the unit disc, uniquely after normalisation.

name: Rouché's theorem
text: two holomorphic functions differing by less than `|f|` on a circle have the same number of zeros inside it.

name: Hurwitz's theorem
text: a locally uniform limit of nowhere-vanishing holomorphic functions is nowhere vanishing or identically zero.

name: Montel's selection theorem
text: a locally bounded sequence of holomorphic functions has a locally uniformly convergent subsequence.

name: Vitali's convergence theorem
text: a locally bounded sequence converging on a set with a limit point converges locally uniformly on the whole connected domain.

name: The Schwarz reflection principle
text: across the real axis, an affine line, a circle, and an analytic arc.

name: The infinitesimal Schwarz–Pick inequality
text: a holomorphic self-map of the disc does not increase the hyperbolic metric; with the hyperbolic triangle inequality.

name: The de Finetti–Ryll-Nardzewski theorem
text: an exchangeable sequence is a mixture of i.i.d. sequences, with contractable ⟺ exchangeable ⟺ mixed i.i.d.

name: The Hewitt–Savage zero-one law
text: an exchangeable event for an i.i.d. sequence has probability 0 or 1.

name: Lévy's downward theorem
text: for an antitone filtration `𝔽`, the conditional expectations `μ[f | 𝔽 n]` converge a.e. to the conditional expectation given the intersection σ-algebra, complementing Mathlib's upward theorem.

name: The directing measure
text: the random measure an exchangeable sequence is conditionally i.i.d. on, with its mixture identity.

name: Hermite functions as Fourier eigenfunctions
text: the Hermite functions diagonalise the Fourier transform, in the rescaling matched to Mathlib's `exp(-2πixξ)` convention.

name: Bernstein functions
text: nonnegative with completely monotone derivative, with their relation to completely monotone functions.

name: Harnack's inequality on a planar disk
text: the two-sided comparison of a nonnegative harmonic function with its centre value, and the pairwise form with sharp constant `((R+r)/(R−r))²`.

name: The Wedderburn blocks of a finite group algebra
text: from a Maschke/Artin–Wedderburn presentation of `k[G]` as a product of matrix algebras: `∑ nᵢ² = |G|`, and the block count is the number of conjugacy classes.

name: Generation of the Weyl group by simple reflections
text: with inversion sets and the permutation action.

name: The Maslov and Alexander gradings for grid states
text: the grading formulas underlying grid homology, invariant under grid reflection and half-turn rotation.

name: The monodromy theorem
text: analytic continuation of a germ along the paths of a homotopy rel endpoints always ends in the same germ, with the null-homotopic-loop corollary; proved via a perturbation-stability argument, with continuation along a path itself defined in TauCeti#1523. Mathlib carries an abstract path-lifting form; this is the analytic-continuation statement.

name: Weyl's unitarian trick
text: every finite-dimensional continuous representation of a compact group admits an invariant inner product by Haar averaging, hence is unitarizable.

name: Fitting's lemma
text: an indecomposable module of finite length has a local endomorphism ring, the key input to Krull–Schmidt; Mathlib carries the noetherian Fitting decomposition this builds on.

name: Wedderburn–Artin for central simple algebras
text: a finite-dimensional central simple algebra is a matrix algebra over a **central** division algebra, sharpening the division-algebra form.

name: Frobenius reciprocity
text: the character identity `⟨χ_{Ind f}, χ⟩_G = ⟨f, χ|_H⟩_H` for finite groups: induction is adjoint to restriction at the level of characters.

name: The Hermite polynomials are a Hilbert basis
text: of `L²` of the standard Gaussian — the suitably normalized Hermite polynomials; completeness of the Hermite orthogonal system for the Gaussian weight.

name: The argument principle for a null-homologous cycle
text: the previously announced circle version, extended to arbitrary null-homologous cycles with winding-number weights.

name: Cauchy's integral formula for a null-homologous cycle
text: , for all derivatives — extending the disc version Mathlib carries to the homology form.

name: Eilenberg–MacLane spaces of type K(G,1)
text: aspherical spaces and `K(G,1)`s, with the circle as `K(ℤ,1)` and the torus as `K(ℤⁿ,1)` via their universal covers.

name: Dynkin types
text: the `A/B/C/D/E/F/G` enumeration with its Cartan matrices, as formal data attached to root systems (the labels and their matrices; the classification theorem is not claimed).
